events.name: Something Walks Into the Light
events.intro:
A rest. The fire. The team.

Something walks into the light.

It doesn't hurry. It goes past your lead, which moves over. It sits down in the gap between two of them, as if the gap had been kept.

It looks at the fire. Then at you.

success.text:
It blinks, slowly. The way you do at someone you've been waiting a long time to be seen by.

It's been with you since the first road. Now it's here, and it stays.

It looks back the way you came. A very long way. Every region, every fire, every night you didn't know.

Then it looks at you again, and the answer is: all of it.

It crosses the last of the distance and puts its chin in your palm. It is warm, and heavier than it looks.

It was never going to be anywhere else.
